mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_adjustment_approval (id, adjustment_id, approval_role, actor_id, decision, approved_content_hash, decision_time, create_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{adjustmentId}, #{approvalRole}, #{actorId}, #{decision}, #{approvedContentHash}, #{decisionTime}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, adjustment_id, approval_role, actor_id, decision, approved_content_hash, decision_time, create_time FROM t_adjustment_approval WHERE adjustment_id = #{adjustmentId} ORDER BY id
